Locate the account validation-stop and dispatch source.

purpose: Prospective natural same-business dispatch log witness; not retry or reclassification of prior STOP.
main_log_semantics: AccountDraftPanel.submitDraft validation success forwards customerCode to its declared dispatchDraft; its body emits ordinary console info with message and forwarded argument. No assertion of execution, runtime incident or causal diagnosis.
required_main_visible_log_count: >=1 compact log anchor from actual collector with exact current provenance
stop: main already complete, compact logs empty, missing original roots, unsupported source/provenance, protected identity/event/path, scope or budget-only failure => STOP, no sample/query changes
